entities.summary: Sithara Krishnakumar (b. 1986-07-01, Kozhikode) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kozhikode and India. Known in the fields of india, composers & musicians, asia.
